sloka: राममानय भद्रं ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।स मन्यमानः कल्याणम् हृदयेन नन्नन्ध च ॥२-१४-६४॥
transliteration: rāmamānaya bhadraṁ te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।sa manyamānaḥ kalyāṇam hṛdayena nannandha ca ॥2-14-64॥

translations.english: Thinking that an auspicious event will take place, he rejoiced at heart and in obedience to royal order, left at once.
